verdict.rationale: A GPU can reasonably be asked about headless or CI use, so the axis applies. The only relevant evidence is indirect: the CUDA Toolkit ships a compiler, runtime and libraries, and the card is promoted for PyTorch, Ollama and other inference backends. These imply scripted, programmatic compute, but nothing explicitly documents headless operation or CI integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/display-less operation, CI runner or container support (e.g., GPU passthrough in CI), and hands-on or independent corroboration of automated pipelines.
